description.value:
At 1st level, the red mage receives the Limit Breaks (Dual Spellcasting and Flexibility).

Dual Spellcasting (Su): Allows the red mage to cast 1 healing spell and 1 damaging spell with the same standard action for a duration of 1 round + 1 round per four red mage levels after 1st. MP must be paid for both spells, and both must have a casting time of 1 standard action. Requires only a swift action.

Flexibility (Su): Allows the red mage to change his current HP total and current MP total on the fly. Once per round as a free action, for a duration of 1 round + 1 round per four red mage levels after 1st, the red mage can swap points from HP to MP or MP to HP on a 3 to 1 basis (3 HP to 1 MP), never below 1 hit point. Requires only a swift action.
